title: Jab kiya jayega
body:
jab kiya jayega mehshar may ibadat ka sawaal
aayega aal e payambar ki mohabbat ka sawaal
<<DIVIDER>>
jiske haathon se shajar phoola phala islam ka
aaj dunya kar rahi hai us se bayyat ka sawaal
jab kiya jayega...
<<DIVIDER>>
lab pe aa jaata hai naam abbas ka be-saakhta
jab kabhi aata hai jurrat aur shuja'at ka sawaal
jab kiya jayega...
<<DIVIDER>>
bad'dua karti layeeno ke liye zainab zaroor
saamne hota na gar nana ki ummat ka sawaal
jab kiya jayega...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ki aaghosh may asghar humak kar aa gaye
jab kiya sarwar ne emaan ki himayat ka sawaal
jab kiya jayega...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek taraf akbar sa beta aur maa ki maamta
ek taraf deen e elaahi aur nusrat ka sawaal
jab kiya jayega...
<<DIVIDER>>
poocha qasim ne chale aayenge kya ghar may udoo
aaya jab nanhe se asghar ki shahadat ka sawaal
jab kiya jayega...
